name: Sample Pages 10 — Bulk Send for Approval (Collapsed Panes)
source: User-provided screenshot export from Figma (Sample Full-Screen Modal Bulk Task - 2). Node ID not captured.
description: Bulk Send for Approval with both side panes collapsed into narrow icon rails. Left rail: expand icon button, 'Total: 6' caption, then one initials chip per candidate (e.g. AR, BA, CA, DW, EC, FN) stacked vertically — the selected candidate's chip is highlighted. Right rail: expand icon button + a single document icon button. The center approval actions pane stretches across the freed width. Header, center pane content and footer are identical to page-09.
note: Same shell, modal-header, approval-actions-pane and modal-footer as page-09. Only the two side panes differ (collapsed state).

shell.note: Identical to page-09: full-screen DefaultBrowser modal.

panes-body.description: Same three-pane body as page-09, with left and right panes in collapsed rail state.

candidates-rail.description: Collapsed candidates pane. Top: expand icon button (Ghost). 'Total: 6' caption (text-styles.regular.label-sm, system.text-mute). Vertical stack of candidate initials chips (two-letter initials, text-styles.bold.label-sm): default system.surface-strong background + system.text-body text; selected candidate brand.brand-surface-soft background + brand.brand text + stroke.thin brand.brand border.

approval-actions-pane.note: Identical content to page-09 approval-actions-pane, stretched to the full freed width.

preview-rail.description: Collapsed preview pane. Top: expand icon button (Ghost). Below: document preview icon button (Outlined, brand.brand icon) that re-opens the contract preview.

modal-footer.note: Identical to page-09 modal-footer (Cancel / Send for Approval disabled).

customElementsRegistry.collapsible-pane-rail: 56px collapsed pane rail: expand icon button + stacked initials chips (left) or document icon button (right). Selected chip: brand.brand-surface-soft bg + brand.brand text/border.

paper.viewerBackground: var(--color-brand-brand-surface-soft) (pixel-measured rgb 219,234,254 = existing brand surface token)

_provenance.method: PIL pixel scan of the real Bulk 1 / Bulk 2 screenshots
_provenance.notes: contract text transcribed verbatim incl. 'Contracy Type' typo and 'Systems.Selanjutnya' missing space; paper content below the visible fold was NOT invented; Elabram watermark approximated with low-opacity text; page-10 = both rails collapsed (focus mode)
